o1: Enables several functions, including ATP binding activity; MATH domain binding activity; and microtubule severing ATPase activity. Involved in microtubule severing; oocyte meiotic spindle formation; cytoskeleton organization; female meiotic nuclear division; and negative regulation of meiotic spindle elongation. Is located in meiotic spindle pole and nucleus. Is part of chromatin and katanin complex. Interacts with MEI-2. Is expressed in ciliated neurons; germ line; and head neurons. Orthologous to human KATNA1 (katanin catalytic subunit A1) and KATNAL1 (katanin catalytic subunit A1 like 1).
